landing.tagline: The customizable image CAPTCHA for your site.

sites.title: Sites
sites.noSitesDescription: Create your first site to get started with yCAPTCHA.

createSheet.title: Create a new site
createSheet.description: Add a site to get your API keys for embedding the CAPTCHA widget.

sites.deleteSiteDescription: This will permanently delete this site and all its puzzles. This action cannot be undone.

detail.apiKeysDescription: Use these keys to integrate yCAPTCHA with your site.
detail.regenerateConfirmDescription: This will invalidate your current keys. Any existing widget embeds using the old site key will stop working until you update them.
detail.noPuzzlesYet: No puzzles yet. Create one to start using yCAPTCHA on this site.
detail.deletePuzzleDescription: This will permanently delete this puzzle. Existing captcha sessions using it will stop working.
detail.embedDescription: Copy the code below and paste it into your website.
detail.dangerDescription: Deleting this site will permanently remove all its puzzles and active CAPTCHA widgets will stop working.
detail.deleteSiteConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete this site and all its puzzles. Active CAPTCHA widgets will stop working.

puzzles.title: Puzzles
puzzles.createSiteFirstSuffix: first, then add puzzles to it.
puzzles.noPuzzlesDescription: Create a puzzle to start using yCAPTCHA.
puzzles.deletePuzzleDescription: This will permanently delete this puzzle. Existing captcha sessions using it will stop working.

create.title: Create Puzzle
create.siteDescription: Which site will this puzzle be used on?
create.imageSetDescription: Choose the image pool for this puzzle.
create.promptDescription: The word shown to users after "Select all images with".
create.tagDescription: Tag all images that are correct answers. Each challenge will randomly show {count} of them.
create.correctPerChallengeHelp: How many correct images to show in each 3×3 grid.
create.difficultyHelp: User must select at least {required} of {total} correct {count, plural, one {image} other {images}} to pass.
create.handPickIncorrectHelp: If off, wrong answers are randomly drawn from remaining images.

edit.title: Edit Puzzle
edit.promptDescription: The word shown after "Select all images with".
edit.handPickIncorrectHelp: If off, wrong answers are randomly drawn.
edit.dangerDescription: Deleting this puzzle will remove it from the site. Existing captcha sessions using this puzzle will stop working.

imageSets.title: Image Sets
imageSets.noImageSetsDescription: Create an image set and upload images to use in puzzles.
imageSets.deleteImageSetDescription: This will permanently delete this image set and all its images. You must remove any puzzles using this set first.
imageSets.cannotDeleteDescription: This image set is referenced by the following puzzles. Remove them first.
imageSets.sampleSetsDescription: Import a pre-built image set to get started quickly.

create.title: Create Image Set
create.description: Give your image set a name. You can upload images after creating it.

detail.uploadDescription: Drag and drop or click to select. Non-standard formats (HEIC, TIFF) are auto-converted.
detail.dropOrBrowse: Drop images here or click to browse
detail.noImagesYet: No images yet. Upload some above.
detail.dangerDescription: Deleting this image set will also remove all images from storage. You must remove any puzzles using this set first.
detail.deleteConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete this image set and all its images from storage. You must remove any puzzles using this set first.
detail.errorHeicUnsupported: HEIC not supported by this browser. Please use Safari

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in without a password using biometrics, security keys, or your device.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data including sites, puzzles, image sets, and uploaded images.
deleteAccount.step2Title: Are you sure you want to do this?
deleteAccount.step2Body: This action is permanent and irreversible. All your sites, puzzles, image sets, and uploaded images will be permanently destroyed. Active CAPTCHA widgets on your sites will stop working immediately.
deleteAccount.step3Instruction: To verify, type your email {email} and the phrase {phrase} below.
deleteAccount.step4Body: This is your last chance. After this, there is no going back.
deleteAccount.step4Label: Enter your password to permanently delete your account

puzzlePreview.description: Test how this puzzle works for users.
